fields.description: Issue of MIAMI LIFE ("Florida's Most Influential Weekly") dated April 13, 1935. Prominent editorial content addresses loan-shark lending and calls for legal reforms; extensive commentary debates legal gambling and pari-mutuel racing in Florida, including discussion of state politics and the role of Tallahassee. Additional sections include campus and society columns, nightlife and entertainment listings/advertising, and sports coverage with horse-racing tips and local sporting news.
